name: Firecrawl
description: Data, SEO and Scraping: web scraping/crawling API that turns websites into LLM-ready data (scrape, crawl, map, search, extract, parse).
access_notes: Free self-serve account with API key from firecrawl.dev/app/api-keys, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <FIRECRAWL_API_KEY>'. A keyless tier even allows rate-limited scrape/search/parse calls with no account at all (both direct API and hosted MCP); an API key or OAuth sign-in unlocks the full tool surface and higher limits.
mcp_notes: Official hosted vendor MCP at https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp (keyless, OAuth sign-in, or Bearer API key; open-source firecrawl-mcp-server on GitHub). Composio toolkit exists at composio.dev/toolkits/firecrawl with 29 tools.
uncertainty_notes: supports_webhooks=true based on Firecrawl's documented webhooks for crawl/batch job events in docs.firecrawl.dev; that specific page was not fetched this pass. 'none' auth applies only to the rate-limited keyless tier.

evidence.note: REST API at api.firecrawl.dev; scrape works with no API key to start, free account/API key for higher limits — 'add -H Authorization: Bearer $FIRECRAWL_API_KEY'
Official hosted MCP at mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp with keyless, OAuth sign-in, or API-key (Bearer) auth paths
Official open-source Firecrawl MCP server repo under the firecrawl GitHub org; keyless free tier exposes scrape/search/parse
Composio Firecrawl toolkit page listing 29 tools (scrape, batch scrape, crawl, credit usage, etc.)
